name: glycomaturity_gtex
description: Per-tissue glycosylation enzyme catalog gene sets (6 pathway sets A-F) annotated with GTEx V8 expression

inputs.name: gtex_tstat_tsv
inputs.description: Tab-delimited GTEx t-statistic matrix (genes x tissues), derived from GTEx V8 median TPM. Accepts a local path or the canonical URL: https://storage.googleapis.com/adult-gtex/bulk-gex/v8/rna-seq/GTEx_Analysis_2017-06-05_v8_RNASeQCv1.1.9_gene_median_tpm.gct.gz

parameters.name: expression_threshold
parameters.help: GTEx t-stat threshold used to annotate 'enriched' status in the TSV output. Does not filter genes out; all catalog members are emitted. Default 2.0.

outputs.name: genesets.gmt
outputs.description: GMT file listing all catalog genes for this pathway set and tissue

outputs.name: geneset.tsv
outputs.description: Catalog genes with GTEx t-stat and tissue_status annotation
